featured_reviews.name: Sunil Sharma (Sunny)
featured_reviews.review_text: NES International School IB board has been a milestone in Mulund West Mumbai for some time now. The students coming out of this school have been quite an inspiration in any ways. I had the chance to attend Science festival here which saw an attendance from various International Schools from all over Mumbai. The staff is very friendly and attentive towards the needs of their student and quite responsive as well. The school extends a warm welcome the moment you enter the premises. I highly recommend parents to have their children study here. Good care is taken not only of the academic year but sports plays an important role here as well. Students look quite engaged with their students and the science festival tool them a level above rest with all the interesting working models made by the students. Highly appreciate the efforts put by their Principal in the wellbeing of each and every student.

featured_reviews.name: RajeshreeRohan RuparelTari
featured_reviews.review_text: Very happy with our decision to enrol our daughter in this school. The concept of emerging tech and unit of enquiry revolves around all the topics.  Overall development is the key. I wish all the best to the Nes management.

featured_reviews.name: Leon Verdes
featured_reviews.review_text:
My kids have been associated with NES International School for close to 9 years with a 3 year migration overseas and back. The school  was very helpful with the transition providing the required letters of recommendation and support needed. They helped my kids transition smoothly back after 3 years and bring them up to speed though they rejoined mid-year. The enrichment classes available at the school helped with this transition. Special thanks to NESISM Teachers like Ms.Ludwina, Ms.Preety, Ms.Soumya and all other teaching and support staff for their immense support to the kids.
I truly appreciate the several opportunities this school provides to help kids grow into confident young adults. The TEDx platform available at NESISM at such a young age is truly a mark of the school's belief in making children ready to solve the problems of the world through ideation and execution. Dr.R Vardarajan Sir is a pioneer of quality education and leads his staff in giving their best to make our kids the best version of themselves.

featured_reviews.name: shilpa karania
featured_reviews.review_text:
NESISM  has been a wonderful platform for my daughter's growth — not just academically, but in confidence, expression, and overall personality development. The school offers a warm, encouraging environment and plenty of opportunities for  holistic learning.
What truly stands out is how NESISM supports personality development, confidence building, public speaking, and focuses on life skills with an emphasis on sustainability, helping students become real world ready.

Like most schools, there are a few ups and downs, but nothing that takes away from the overall positive experience. For her journey, NESISM has truly been the right match, helping her blossom beautifully.

featured_reviews.name: Riddhi Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text: I am really happy with the functioning of the school. The way they are introducing new subjects like robotics, etc in junior grade is commendable. The infrastructure is also too good and kid’s friendly. The individual attention every kid gets gives them a proper understanding regarding the subjects on hand.

featured_reviews.name: Immanuel Kale
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had an opportunity to be a Judge for the final corporate round for the grade 3 students.
I was amazed to see the students expressing themselves so confidently. It was so pleasant to see children not only talking about their ambitions but being informed about sustainability, kindness , gratitude equality and oneness. They have so much to offer to our community living. The efforts the school is taking not only for excellence in education but also imbibing children to be a responsible citizen is commendable.
Looking forward to see these champions changing the world for good.

featured_reviews.name: Poonam Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Firstly, who is this Bhoopendra  Chandan?   There is no record of such a teacher having worked at our school, and I believe this is a fake review.
As I am a part of NES International School, Mumbai, since September 2009, I can confidently say that our institution values integrity and dedication.
I have been a proud member of NES International School, Mumbai, since September 2009, and I consider this institution to be my second home. Throughout my 17 years here, the school has always been considerate and supportive. Despite living in Ulhasnagar and commuting all the way to Mulund West, my passion for teaching and the support from the school management motivate me to make this journey every day.
At the end of the day, I find immense satisfaction in guiding my students not only in their subject content but also in their personal growth. I strive to help them create a better and more peaceful world through intercultural understanding and respect. I truly cherish the moments I spend with my students, especially when I see them thriving in various parts of the world.
I would like to express my appreciation for NES International School, Mumbai, where the administration actively recognizes and rewards teachers based on their abilities and performances. I have had the privilege of attending numerous gatherings organized to honor the hard work and dedication of the teaching staff.
Additionally, the school has arranged enriching trips for teachers, accompanied by school authorities, which not only foster camaraderie but also enhance our professional development. I firmly believe in the values of hard work and dedication in my teaching profession at NES International School, and I am grateful for the supportive environment that encourages our growth and commitment.

Ms. Poonam Singh

featured_reviews.name: Dhanapriya Manish
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently visited this school and to be honest, this is one of the best schools in Mumbai which provides an IB curriculum. The students were so well behaved and confident to interact with. The school has so many features and activities engulfed apart from its curriculum that a child is not only seen being moulded well but also aiming at international scholars. It was such an amazing experience for me and I highly recommend this school and look forward for more such wonderful opportunities to come back to this institution again.

owner_posts.post_text: Parents in Chembur often ask when is the right time to enrol in an international school. The answer lies in three natural stages. Ages 3 to 5 is the smoothest entry: children settle before formal academic pressure begins, developing curiosity and language skills through play-based, inquiry-led learning. Around Grade 6, students transition into independent thinking and project-driven work, building confidence before the senior years. From Grade 9, learners begin IGCSE and progress to the IB Diploma or A Levels, qualifications recognised by universities worldwide. Each stage offers a different advantage, but every one leads to the same outcome: a future-ready learner. Chembur families, find your child's ideal entry point at JBCN International School. Speak with our admissions team today.

Wondering if the IB curriculum is the right path for your child? The IB Diploma is accepted at every Indian university and across more than 150 countries worldwide, giving students an edge no matter where their ambitions take them. What makes it truly stand out is that learning goes far beyond textbooks, nurturing critical thinking, independent research, and meaningful community involvement as core parts of the programme. Yes, the workload is rigorous and consistency is key, but students who commit to it graduate with exactly the skills universities look for on day one. In fact, studies show IB students are far more likely to secure a place at a top university and graduate with first class honours. At JBCN International School, Chembur, the best IB school in Chembur, students are supported every step of the way through expert faculty, one on one university counselling, and structured mentorship that turns the challenge into an achievement. Get in touch today and set your child on the path to a world class future!

CBSE, ICSE, IGCSE, or IB? Choosing the right board is one of the biggest decisions you’ll make for your child’s future. Every board offers something different. CBSE is a great fit for students preparing for Indian competitive exams, ICSE builds strong language and academic skills, IGCSE gives students global exposure and flexibility, while IB focuses on critical thinking, research, and real-world learning that universities around the world value.

The best choice comes down to your child’s learning style, strengths, and future aspirations, not just rankings or trends.

If you are looking for the best IB school in Chembur, JBCN offers the IB Diploma Programme with student averages consistently above the global benchmark. Visit the campus and see how learning comes alive at JBCN.

Wondering what your 6-year-old should know academically? At JBCN Chembur, we believe early learning is about building strong foundations, not racing ahead. At age six, children develop reading comprehension, number sense, writing confidence, and curiosity-driven thinking at their own pace. Our educators focus on nurturing each child's natural love for learning through age-appropriate, play-based exploration. Recognised as the best international school in Chembur, JBCN creates a secure and stimulating environment where young learners grow holistically. If you are looking for the right start for your child, explore admissions at JBCN Chembur today.

featured_reviews.review_text:
The school was wonderful during the admission process.
Unfortunately, once kids are in school, it seemed hey don't care at all about kids wellbeing.
My kids was physically hurt, and the teacher didn't thought they need to call us. We needed to chase them multiple time to get a response.
The year after, when my kid was bullied, the teacher kept saying it is just misunderstanding.
It reached a place where my son refused to continue in school, stating he rather stay home and have no fiends at all than experiencing the bulling every day.
Since transferring to a new school mid 2nd term my son is happy going to school, engaging in class and while he still doesn't have many friends, he is in a much happier disposition.

I am sure the school is happy he has eft as the principle himself stated this is not the place for us instead of solving communication problems i n the past, but I would still caution every new parents to check how the school treat actual problems.

I do must state that some of the teachers are wonderful such as my daughter's, but the overall tone of the school cannot be saved by so little.

name: Bodhi Vidyalaya – A Nature-Based School inspired by the philosophies of Rudolf Steiner and J. Krishnamurti.
description:
The first alternative school in Mulund — a school started by parents.

We focus on how a child learns, rather than just how to teach a child.

At Bodhi, we understand that each child learns in a unique way. There are certain universal truths or principles about how children learn, and we are on a journey to discover them — so we can better support each child in developing their true self and becoming a Bodhi.

Our approach is inspired by the philosophies of Waldorf education and J. Krishnamurti valuing inner growth, self-awareness, and a deep connection to nature and learning through experience.
